chunks: And it was named Bakkah because the people press against one another there with their hands.

key_terms.النَّاسَ: the people, referring to those gathered there
key_terms.بَعْضُهُمْ: some of them, indicating mutual crowding
key_terms.بَكَّةَ: Bakkah, the sacred place being described by this name
key_terms.بِالْأَيْدِي: with the hands, describing the physical manner of crowding
key_terms.يَبُكُّ: they press or crowd one another

ai.seo_question: Why is Makkah called Bakkah in hadith literature?
ai.summary: This report explains the naming of Bakkah by linking it to the crowding of people in that sacred place. It reflects the intense gathering associated with hajj and the physical closeness of pilgrims there.
